candidate_relations.reason: The patient presents with fever, neck stiffness, elevated CSF white blood cell count with neutrophilic predominance, and a positive CSF culture, all pointing towards an infection. The MRI findings of hyperintense lesions with contrast enhancement are also consistent with an infectious process. There is no evidence in the record to suggest lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: The clinical record describes an infectious process, not a neoplastic one.
